tools.name: check_bet
tools.description: Check a specific sports bet against thousands of play-by-play game simulations: each leg's simulated probability, the sportsbook's implied probability, and the edge. Send the bet as plain text - teams or players, market, line, odds. A parlay in one string is graded leg by leg and priced as a whole.
